issue.title: プロダクト全体のデザインを全面リファインする

summary: Serve as the cross-surface acceptance issue for a calm, operational, human-approved UI after the component issues land.
decisions: Treat this as a final acceptance umbrella, not a parallel rewrite of the same screens.
Use the green, calm, operational design system and keep approval/data hierarchy primary.
Verify responsive, keyboard, loading, empty, error, partial, and locked states.

out: A second implementation of child issues

risks.description: A broad redesign may duplicate work and create merge conflicts.
risks.mitigation: Land child issues first; limit this issue to shared design tokens, layout, defects, and acceptance.

risks.description: Polished happy paths may hide missing operational states.
risks.mitigation: Require browser evidence for loading, empty, sync error, partial, locked, and confirmation states.

gates.description: Approve the final desktop and mobile surface screenshots.

acceptanceCriteria: All primary routes share a coherent visual and interaction system.
Approval actions are visually distinct and never implied to be autonomous.
Loading, empty, sync error, partial, mock, billing lock, AI limit, and write confirmation states have explicit text.
Visual acceptance does not regress child issue behavior.

rollback.strategy: Revert shared token/layout changes while retaining previously verified child functionality.
rollback.verification: Run all child browser scenarios and compare the approved baseline screenshots.
